classes.description: Resource Group — 资源组/排程组定义实体。将多个 Resource 按排程或统计需求分组管理。支持嵌套子分组(groups)和包含条目(entries)，可配置 defaultForObjectTypes 自动指派。 【Swagger】Schema: ResourceGroupEntity；来源文件: ResourceGroups.json；API: /api/ResourceGroups。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 设置/换线权限配置 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: scsAllowMultiStepsTrackIn
properties.description: 物理字段 scsAllowMultiStepsTrackIn 【Swagger】Flag to indicate allow multi steps track in if requirements are same.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注信息 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标 ID 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: name
properties.description: 资源组的唯一名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: entryType
properties.description: 条目对象类型名称（CDO Definition Name） 【Swagger】Name of the type of objects (CDO Definition Name) contained in this ObjectGroup. There is no business logic support for this field and it will be eventually removed.

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list
